commands:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=f8d654a8809802805c4fce869fee4ea3b554adb327f9e710b7d1dcbc47ea7f1a
NAME='portrait_plotter_150x150mm(1).svg'
SRC=$(python3 - "$EXPECTED" "$NAME" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, subprocess, sys
expected, name = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
home = Path.home()
cands = {home/'Downloads'/name, home/'Desktop'/name, home/'Documents'/name}
try:
    out = subprocess.check_output(['mdfind', name], text=True, timeout=15)
    cands.update(Path(x) for x in out.splitlines() if x.strip())
except Exception:
    pass
for p in sorted(cands, key=lambda x: str(x)):
    try:
        if not p.is_file():
            continue
        h = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if h == expected:
            print(p)
            raise SystemExit(0)
    except OSError:
        pass
raise SystemExit('exact uploaded SVG not found on host by filename/hash')
PY
)
echo SOURCE_FOUND="$SRC"
git fetch origin plot-inbox
git reset --hard origin/plot-inbox
DEST=projects/kobra2-neo/inbox/current.svg
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$DEST")"
cp "$SRC" "$DEST"
ACTUAL=$(shasum -a 256 "$DEST" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"
git add "$DEST"
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo RESULT:ARTWORK_ALREADY_PINNED source_sha256=$ACTUAL commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
else
  git commit -m 'Stage exact 150mm portrait SVG for plotting'
  git push origin HEAD:plot-inbox
  echo RESULT:ARTWORK_PINNED source_sha256=$ACTUAL commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
fi
